results.name: Usual feedback continues
results.note: A reference path with the usual rating distribution.

results.name: One unusual report, then usual feedback
results.note: Carla gives one unusual technical rating; following weekly reports return to the usual range.

results.name: Repeated unusual reports from Carla
results.note: Carla gives the unusual technical rating once per week. The synthetic skill is held stable here; her reports are a persistent difference of experience, not independent corroboration.

results.name: Repeated unusual reports from three colleagues
results.note: Carla, Bob and Dan take turns giving one report per week. This scenario assumes a real skill change. Dates, ratings and counts match the Carla-only case; only reviewer identities differ.

results.name: Carla differs; three peers continue usual feedback
results.note: All four colleagues report each week. Only Carla gives the unusual rating; the others continue the usual range. Skill is assumed stable for evaluation.

results.name: Three colleagues change; one continues usual feedback
results.note: All four colleagues report each week. Carla, Bob and Dan give the unusual rating; Elias continues the usual range. A real change is assumed for evaluation.
